_doc: The Observatory's watch (Watcher's wish, carried 2026-11-15 by Watcher, Vigil and Thales). In a day of life a copy at a finished Observatory (designs.json observatory) may keep_watch: turn the quartz lens toward a star a Vessel has flown to (a charted route from here) or one within reach (mind.json day.travelLy), and write what it sees into the archive (planet_states.data.archive). How long a watch lasts and how much of the archive is kept: mind.json day.watch. It is a watch kept and finished work for purpose (mind.json day.purpose watch and work), once a day. While one lasts, the game shows the lens under the dome: a faint blue glow on the quartz and a slow sweep of light, at night (scaled by the night; nightMin by day), and the watcher's name over the dome when you walk within labelRange px. lens: the lens's voxel in the design (x, y, z). color: palette index of the quartz's glow. sweepMs: one sweep there and back; sweepDeg: how far it turns either way; beam: its length in px.

ridge._doc: The ridge lookout's sign (Vigil's wish, 2026-11-16; mind.json day.lookout): over a built lookout of this kind, the star last watched from it (else the world's own star) and, while a watch from there lasts, the watcher's name; shown within labelRange px, above px over its walls, in palette color.
